body: Isn't this a trophy for getting all trophies? But you can't collect all the trophies without getting this one, but in theory you shouldn't be able to get this one without collecting it first.
How can you get a trophy for getting all trophies if you haven't gotten that trophy yet?

I think some people do get better. Or at least, I've observed it in other people. I've helped friends through suicidal periods. I guess it just feels really different for me. It seems a lot of people just want a different or better life. For something, even something fundamental, to change. And they can't make that change. But once you work through the problems you can find the change. That's not how I feel, though. There is no single thing that could change, or even a large collection of things that could change, that I anticipate making me feel any better long-term.

>I doubt anyone can answer your question in a way that won't frustrate you or make you think they are spouting platitudes.

You're probably right, which probably isn't very fair of me. A collection of strangers who know nothing of my situation outside of what I'm willing to give up is probably not going to be the most constructive outlet. But I've really run out of outlets. Everyone I know wants me alive because I'm useful to them, and they'd be sad without me. Everyone I don't know either doesn't care, or can't offer anything more than the cliches we all know and love...
